title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: Inactivity, Dormancy and Reactivation
content:
A Savings & Money Market Accounts product that the owner leaves untouched for long enough is classed as dormant. This page defines the activity that keeps an account awake, when dormancy begins, what a dormant account is charged and earns, and what brings it back to active status.

## What counts as the owner's own activity

Activity initiated by the customer means a deposit or a withdrawal that the owner personally makes: at a branch, at an ATM, by mobile deposit, by a transfer through online banking, the mobile app or telephone banking, by money market check, or by wire.

None of the following is activity of the owner's own: an overdraft protection transfer, an automatic transfer, an ACH credit, a fee, the refund of a fee, or an interest credit.

The account keeps a latest-activity date: the date of the most recent activity of the owner's own.

## When dormancy begins

An active account turns dormant once the tier's inactivity period, in calendar months, has run from the latest-activity date. The months are counted from that date; the account is due to be classed dormant when the current date is on or after the latest-activity date carried forward by that many months. If that month is too short to contain the matching day, its final day serves instead.

| Tier | Inactivity period (calendar months) | Dormant account fee per statement cycle (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | 24 | 0.00 |
| Statement Savings | 24 | 3.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | 24 | 0.00 |
| Money Market Account | 24 | 5.00 |
| Premier Money Market | 24 | 5.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | 36 | 0.00 |

## While the account is dormant

- At every cycle close the tier's dormant account fee is charged, but only up to the balance available, so the account is never pushed under zero, and nothing is charged when the balance is already zero.
- No monthly maintenance fee is charged for a cycle in which the account is dormant.
- Interest keeps accruing.

## Leaving dormancy

A dormant account goes back to active only for an owner whose identity has been verified, as the verification record for that customer shows, and only through a transaction of the owner's own made within the same contact. The date of that transaction becomes the new latest-activity date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, 24-month tier)

- Latest activity 31 August 2023: dormancy is due from 31 August 2025. On 30 August 2025 the account is still active.
- Latest activity 29 February 2024: February 2026 has no 29th, so dormancy is due from 28 February 2026.

## Dormant fee illustration (hypothetical Money Market Account balances)

| Balance at cycle close | Dormant fee charged |
|---|---|
| 40.00 | 5.00 |
| 2.00 | 2.00, reduced to the balance |
| 0.00 | none |
